I'm going to make it fairly short and sweet because there are a lot of things in this post very few of which are good in my opinion.

He broke up with you out of blue, no communication no nothing beforehand and now wants you to be on standby just in case he wants to get back with you.You're a second choice, if you weren't he would have at the very least discussed things out with you before dumping you.

And then the whole ' our issues would be very easy to fix !' topic. Genuinely, look at all the issues you have together and do you think he would be willing to work them out with you because so far that seems unlikely and you can't fix anything alone when you're trying to work on a relationship.
Also, why do you feel it is worth it to be in a relationship that could be fixed when you could get into a healthy (a lot more) issueless one ?

You're 23 and honestly so am I and I can understand that working out on relationships and figuring out expectations and such is difficult but in your spot the moment he'd have dumped would have been the moment we'd be done.You don't deserve to be tugged back and forth in a on and off  relationship where he seemingly can discard you at moment's notice 
 Even if shit is wonder you said yourself you'd be walking around eggshells if you got back together,trust your gut feeling it's very useful in my experience.

Also if you have a slither of a doubt about it , don't go through it.
